answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A wander of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
